opportunities.name: Weekend city trip planning and email draft
opportunities.description: For a destination city: look up Wikipedia and timeanddate facts, search Booking for a hotel on given dates, find a Viator activity, find an OpenTable dinner, save a summary note, and draft an email to a friend.
opportunities.site: wikipedia, timeanddate, booking, viator, opentable, notes, mail
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia and open its article
Search the city on timeanddate and open its weather page
On Booking, enter the destination, pick the check-in and check-out dates and search
Open the first hotel and view Info & prices
On Viator, search for an activity in the city and open the first result
On OpenTable, search for a cuisine in the city, pick the date and search, then open the first restaurant
In Notes, type a summary of the city facts, hotel, activities and dinner, then press Enter
In Mail, fill To, Subject and Body with the plan, then click Discard

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15, Thames boat and Tower of London, London Indian dinner, maya@example.com
Edinburgh, Jan 15-17, whisky tasting and Highlands day trip, Edinburgh Scottish dinner, priya@example.com

opportunities.name: Booking hotel search by destination, dates and guests
opportunities.description: On Booking, enter a destination, choose check-in and check-out dates and guest count, search, open the top hotel and view Info & prices.
steps: Clear and click the destination field
Type the destination and select the matching option
Open the date picker and select check-in and check-out dates
Open the occupancy selector, adjust adults and click Done

opportunities.name: Viator activity search
opportunities.description: On Viator, replace the search query with an activity or place, choose the Search suggestion and open the first result.

opportunities.name: OpenTable restaurant search by cuisine, city and date
opportunities.description: On OpenTable, type a location or cuisine query, pick a date, click search and open the top restaurant.
steps: Open the date selector and navigate to the month
Click Let's go or Find a table

opportunities.name: Look up a city on Wikipedia and timeanddate
opportunities.description: Search a city on Wikipedia and open its article, then search the same city on timeanddate and open its weather page.
steps: Search the city in Wikipedia and click the top suggestion

opportunities.name: Save trip summary note then draft and discard an email
opportunities.description: In Notes, save a trip summary, then in Mail fill To, Subject and Body for a recipient and click Discard.
steps: Click New note and type the summary, then press Enter
